title: Fonts
description: Four families from Visual direction, each with a system fallback stack (owner accepted 2026-11-16). Single source: src/fonts.config.mjs builds the Astro Fonts API config from this file, and Astro emits --font-<name> (family, our own metric-matched fallback face from src/css/global/fonts.css, then the stack). Files are in src/assets/fonts (scripts/subset-fonts.sh).
